Indian Fertilizer Vessels Safely Cross Strait of Hormuz Amid Regional Tensions

Fifteen Indian vessels carrying fertilizers and raw materials have successfully navigated the Strait of Hormuz, a critical maritime chokepoint. The Indian government confirmed the safe passage, stating it ensures the country's fertilizer supply. This development occurs amidst heightened regional tensions in the Middle East, which have raised concerns about shipping safety.
